choppiness_filter.computation: abs(close[i] - close[i-lookback+1]) / sum(high[j] - low[j] for j in [i-lookback+1..i])

dr2.computation: r2[i] - r2[i-1] where r2 = linear regression R-squared on close over lookback bars
dr2.interpretation: negative = R2 falling = trend dissolving = favorable for rotation entry

dslope.computation: abs(slope[i]) - abs(slope[i-1]) where slope = linear regression slope on close
dslope.interpretation: negative = abs_slope falling = trend weakening = favorable for rotation entry

entry_signal_filter.gate_behavior: skip entry when dr2 > -0.40 OR dslope > -2.0 (applied after chop filter)

fade_confirm_filter.prev_bar: last completed 250-tick aggregated bar before the entry bar
fade_confirm_filter.guard: if prev_bar range == 0, set fade_confirm = 0.5 (neutral, passes filter)
fade_confirm_filter.guard_nan: if prev_bar data unavailable (warmup), allow entry
fade_confirm_filter.gate_behavior: skip entry when fade_confirm >= 0.40 (applied after entry signal filter)

three_state_logic.d2_ema9 > 0.5: EMA accelerating up: allow LONGs, block SHORTs
three_state_logic.d2_ema9 < -0.5: EMA accelerating down: allow SHORTs, block LONGs

ema_directional_entry_gate.gate_behavior: skip entry when trade direction opposes d2_ema9 outside neutral zone (applied after fade_confirm filter)

computation.d2_avg3: mean(d2_ema9[i], d2_ema9[i-1], d2_ema9[i-2]) on completed 250-tick bars

hold_logic.at_reversal_trigger: when price moves step_dist in favor (normal reversal exit point), check d2_avg3 alignment
hold_logic.aligned: d2_avg3 > 0 for LONG, d2_avg3 <= 0 for SHORT
hold_logic.if_aligned: skip reversal exit, hold position, update anchor to current price
hold_logic.if_not_aligned: normal reversal exit + re-enter opposite direction
hold_logic.exit_condition: exit when d2_avg3 flips against direction (D2_EXIT), or hard stop, or EOD

ema_directional_hold.gate_behavior: delay reversal exit when d2_avg3 aligned with trade direction; exit on d2_avg3 flip

sanity_checks.entry_gate: PASS - E[R]=$100.03 beats all 10 random seeds (max=$79.00, margin=$21.03)
sanity_checks.in_trade_hold: PASS - E[R]=$177.81 beats all 10 random seeds (max=$84.00, margin=$93.81)

killed_entry: d_ema9 (redundant with ema_spread rho=0.72, 29% retention as gate)
killed_hold: BE trail variants (exits trades at breakeven that would recover, hurts E[R])

key_findings: d2_ema9 (EMA9 curvature) is the strongest directional signal — not ema_spread or d_ema9
No inversion: with-trend curvature outperforms against-trend (unlike Track B which inverted)
LONG when d2<=0 is the only money-losing subgroup in A+B filtered population (E[R]=-$4.10)
In-trade d2 monitoring provides larger improvement (+128%) than entry gate (+28%)
Entry gate and hold are near-additive (synergy +$1.80) — operate on different dimensions
ema_spread and d_ema9 are redundant (rho=0.72); d2_ema9 is independent of both
